name: uberasm-swap-players-after-death-for-retry-patch
title: Swap Players After Death (for Retry Patch)
description:
if 2 players are playing, this switches(swaps) player after death.

- Intended to use with retry.asm (retry patch) tested with 2.06a.
- Use it with gamemode 10 in UberASM tool.
- there are extra instructions in "retry ram.gif"

If some of the above is not clear, I included a step by step in the readme. Hopefully this helps.
